name: Grid-sync cooperative-groups reduction
description: A single-kernel cooperative-groups grid-wide sum reduction (cg::this_grid()+grid.sync() via cudaLaunchCooperativeKernel) contrasted with a two-kernel-launch tree reduction combining the same per-block partial sums.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: reduceBlock reproduced verbatim and reduceSinglePassMultiBlockCG reproduced with a mechanical float->double type change, from NVIDIA/cuda-samples reductionMultiBlockCG.cu. reduceBlockPartial/reduceCombinePartials (two-launch counterpart), host driver, gen_val, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new. Snapshot sk-09.
notes: Real-extraction grid-sync case from collection snapshot sk-09. n=262144, input[i]=((i%23)-11)*0.5, scalar sum = -32.5. Requires cooperative-launch-capable GPU; exact oracle.
